description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart illustrating average accuracy across eleven datasets for various training methods. The horizontal axis displays the training method categories: “Standard”, “CINQS”, and “CINQS-VLM”, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents average accuracy, labeled as “Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each training method, there are three bars representing performance on the datasets “Pope”, “Llava-W”, and “Amber”, visually grouped together. The “Standard” method bars are colored light blue, with “Pope” at approximately 84.7, “Llava-W” at approximately 74.2, and “Amber” at approximately 56.8. The “CINQS” method bars are colored dark blue, showing “Pope” at approximately 88.8, “Llava-W” at approximately 82.6, and “Amber” at approximately 58.7. Finally, the “CINQS-VLM” method bars are colored a medium blue, with “Pope” at approximately 88.5, “Llava-W” at approximately 82.1, and “Amber” at approximately 58.6. The bars are arranged in a non-descending order based on training method, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
